Name: RoseDryad's Fairydew Bobbers
Author: RoseDryad
Description:
Featuring bobbers in the following designs: 5 round, 3 flowers, 3 mushroom, 3 roses, 1 snail, 1 tiny fairy, 4 butterflies, 2 leaf sprouts, 1 acorn, 1 leaf, 4 fairy potions, 4 seed packets, 4 lanterns, and 4 fairies.

This mod comes in two versions:

[list]
[*][b]Bebber Bobbers[/b] - Adds 40 new bobber styles to the Bobber Machine (without replacing the originals).
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b] (with Generic Mod Config Menu) - Replaces the existing bobbers with this fairycore set.
Each bobber can be individually enabled or disabled using the config menu.[/list]
[u]Requirements:[/u]
[list]
[*] [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36655]Bebber Bobbers[/url]
[*] ﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (*Only for CP version!)﻿
[/list]
